prompt_text: A kodama tree spirit from Princess Mononoke, a small pale ghostly forest imp. A big smooth pale dome head with a scatter of small dark holes for a face, a little rounded pale body, short spindly limbs, smooth eggshell-white featureless skin. Quietly eerie, strange and faintly mischievous, hand-sculpted like a weathered stone maquette in muted natural colours. Seen from a three-quarter view angle, standing full body, centred, the whole figure visible, even soft studio lighting, plain neutral background.
